name: Hall Thick Terminal Three-Repair Obstruction
definition: Use Hall's 299-concept cornerless seed and repair tips $a_0=183$, $a_+=315$, and $a_-=1836$. On layer coordinates $E=\{p,q\}$, assign the signed facets $(p,0),(q,0)$ to $a_0$, $(p,1)$ to $a_+$, and $(q,1)$ to $a_-$. Equivalently, use rows $R_0=Q_E\setminus\{(1,1)\}$, $R_+=\{t:t_p=1\}$, and $R_-=\{t:t_q=1\}$.
parameters: The resulting family has $4\cdot299+3+2+2=1203$ concepts and isometric dimension 14.
properties: The signed-facet partition theorem makes the family a corner-descent-terminal ample forbidden pc-minor. Every one of its fourteen coordinates has two nonempty exclusive sections whose total order is at least three. Thus coordinate thickness does not distinguish terminal common-seed obstructions from terminal obstructions outside that construction.
